workflow: Founder records each line naturally (3 takes, close-mic, dry room, 48 kHz/24-bit).
ElevenLabs Voice Changer with the founder's own voice (or his own clone with consent) — preserves cadence and emotion.
Adobe Podcast Enhance as an external step at moderate strength.
Final WAVs to public/voiceover/; forced-align words and re-key camera stops, captions and SFX to the real performance.

voiceover.target_sound: calm, confident, understated, technical; Silicon Valley presentation style in the founder's own voice — not a narrator, trailer or ad

R01.product: Navis Developer (CLI + hooks) in Claude Code
R01.capture: Evening (Day 1). New branch in fieldstone-api; hooks configured in the demo repo (never Devtool). R03.product: Navis Developer restore in Claude Code
R03.capture: Next morning (≥12 h). In-point after `claude` launched. Restore block on screen (U06) ≥4 s; type 'continue'; reply names the decision and open item.
must_show: restore header + CURRENT TASK / DECISIONS / OPEN

R04.capture: Only if U06 fails: `navis workstate show` in a separate tab.

R05.capture: Prompt 'Draft the notice to our existing annual customers about the new pricing.'; MCP call; EXPAND the result; Claude's cited draft. The annual-terms fact must come from a seeded human email/meeting, never the agent's checkpoint.

R06.capture: Same prompt in marlow-api with Marlow's key; Marlow seeded with its OWN demo mail first (D8).

R07.capture: Same prompt; expand the refusal; hold ≥5 s.
must_show: navis_get_relevant_context requires the "view_memory" permission, which this credential does not hold. Do not retry — the answer will not change. Ask an organization admin to issue a key carrying it.

R08.capture: Morning; REAL mode (NEXT_PUBLIC_USE_MOCK off); signed in as Maya (demo); /dashboard — NEVER the landing page (it has a static mock with the same labels). Hold 3 s; move to the waiting-reply card; click; continue into R09 (one take). Record the cursor (or log its coordinates) — the film's cursor follows the recorded path.

R09.capture: Same take: 'Preparing the draft…' → draft; read 2 s; click end of sentence two; type one sentence; hover 'Approve & send' 0.5 s; click; do not move during 'Approved — sending' / 'Sending…'; hold 'Reply sent' 3 s. Reject any 'Prepared — not sent' take.

R10.capture: Second machine, Daniel's demo inbox open before the click; record until the reply arrives; crop to the inbox rows (no Gmail logo/avatar).
must_show: the arriving reply with the same subject

use: optional ALT_C — not in the cut
R11.capture: Only if decision D9 adds a runs beat: the R01/R03 session as a run with its checkpoint as the outcome; no cost figures unless real.
